page.overview:
Who is Ob Nixilis?

Ob Nixilis (/ɑːb nɪksɪlɪs/ OB niks-ILL-iss) was a human warlord and tyrant who became a planeswalker when he discovered that he was manipulated by demons to be the sole survivor of a world that only knew war. He became a demon himself after being cursed by the Chain Veil. In New Capenna, he is called The Adversary. He lost his spark in the Great Pruning.

While being a brilliant tactician, wizard, and warrior, Ob Nixilis had also studied the history of his world, where society had been destroyed consecutively in cataclysmic and destructive wars only interrupted by mere decades of peace. He came to believe that every society was doomed to collapse at one point and that the only thing that mattered was taking as much for yourself as you could before the collapse occurred. As a result, he resorted to treachery and underhanded tactics without much thought.

Due to his curse, he is now a black-horned, winged, and tailed demon. In this form, Ob Nixilis wields a form of magic that acts like anti-life magic, contrasting other forms of death magic like necromancy. With it, he can weaken his enemies, erode solid matter, and even consume the life energy of other beings to increase his power. He also managed to control a few Eldrazi drones, although how exactly isn't clear.

Ob Nixilis is primarily black-aligned, and secondary in red mana. As Ob Nixilis planeswalks, he disappears in flame.
